REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL
TO PROVIDE INVESTMENT MANAGER SERVICES FOR BROWARD EDUCATION FOUNDATION, INC.
I. BACKGROUND INFORMATION
The Broward Education Foundation, Inc. was incorporated on August 8, 1983 under Chapter 617 of the Florida Statutes as a 501[c] 3 not-for-profit corporation for educational and charitable purposes. The general nature, objectives and purpose of the Foundation are to provide private sector resources to support academic excellence for the Broward County public school teachers and students from kindergarten through high school.
The Foundation’s Investment Assets as of June 30, 2015 were approximately $4.6 million. Presently several categories of designated and undesignated investment assets are maintained. The Investment Assets are approximately:

result.title: II. PROPOSAL COMPONENTS
key_items: B. Client Information; C. Investment Manager Search; D. Performance Measurement and Evaluation
result.summary: The RFP lists Foundation funds: $1.565M agency funds, $1.811M long-term reserves, $300K unrestricted reserves, $719K restricted to specific programs, $167K restricted to nonspecific programs, and $84K restricted nonspecific scholarships. Proposals must describe the consulting firm, responsible staff and account loads, experience, affiliations/conflict safeguards, fiduciary status, litigation, education services, and institutional assets managed; provide client references and three-year client gains/losses; explain support for return objectives, manager categorization and selection, performance reporting and verification, and rebalancing; and detail fees, expenses, custodial services, soft-dollar disclosure, and performance evaluation. Firms must affirm nondiscrimination. Proposals are limited to five single-spaced pages, excluding appendices. Evaluation considers references and demonstrated performance, cost, team structure/experience/availability, and possible oral presentations. The Foundation may reject proposals, waive minor inconsistencies, or request information, and will select the best-qualified firm. Submit six copies to the named Foundation CEO by 5 p.m. July 1, 2016; selection and notification are due by September 15. Late or incomplete proposals are excluded.

result.title: Proposal Requirements, Evaluation, and Submission
key_items: III. BREVITY OF PROPOSALS; V. SUBMISSION OF PROPOSALS
result.summary: Firms are asked whether they provide custodial services, disclose soft-dollar compensation, and how their performance should be evaluated in an ongoing relationship. They must affirm nondiscrimination across listed protected characteristics in employment and compensation decisions. Proposals are limited to five single-spaced pages, excluding supporting documents and addenda. Evaluation considers demonstrated performance and references, cost, management-team structure, experience and availability, and possibly an oral presentation. Broward Education Foundation may reject any or all proposals, waive minor inconsistencies, or request additional information; it will award the contract to the organization judged best qualified. Submit six copies to the Foundation’s President and CEO at the specified Fort Lauderdale address by 5 p.m. July 1, 2016. Selection was scheduled by September 15, with all proposers to be notified; late or incomplete proposals will not be considered.
